parts.t: DEVELOPMENT PROPERTY! 1.44 Acres in the Smith NCP. This lot is designated for (4 units per acre). Buyer to confirm all land use with township of Langley. Great holding property with lots of future development opportunities. You will not be able to find a similar lot again that is flat and has no creeks or watercourses. Nice, clean, and cozy home with good conditions to move in or rent out. Priced for lot value only, do not walk on property. Information package upon request.
